_help._file: The 3 AI personalities — a rock-paper-scissors (Muzzy, 2026-10-04): Scholar beats Survivor, Survivor beats Strategist, Strategist beats Scholar. WHAT each one wants and what it can SEE. (How well it plays is the skill — skills.json.) Starting values from the original game's festive-booth AI (research/original-digest.md §2); the Personality Check (feel-targets.json) tunes them. Notes are keyed by the setting's name inside ONE personality, so they fit every personality in the list.
_help.id: The personality's name in code. Its name and bio for players live in content/text/en.json → ai.personality.<id>.
_help.traits: Seven traits, each a range 0–100. Every turn it picks a value inside each range, so it leans the same way but never plays exactly alike twice. A higher trait = its goal wins the goal roll more often.
_help.traits.aggression: TRAP — hem rival glyphlings in, cut their moves, tangle them, take territory.
_help.traits.greed: SCORE — make the most Magic this turn.
_help.traits.spite: DENY — block a rival's lines and near-words; toss a weed where a rival would score.
_help.traits.caution: ESCAPE — keep its own glyphlings roomy and safe; keep pockets only it can reach.
_help.traits.patience: BUILD — set up its own future words (gaps, extensions, crossings).
_help.traits.opportunism: STEAL — grow a rival's word into one it owns most of.
_help.traits.pragmatism: DUMP — shed junk letters, far from every glyphling.
_help.goals: The goal roll walks this list in order: each goal rolls against its trait; the first to succeed is the turn's main goal (all fail → the first one).
_help.nudge: 0–1. How much the OTHER goals count when scoring a move: each adds up to nudge × its trait ÷ 100. 0 = only the main goal (the original AI); higher = it favours two-birds moves.
_help.focus: 0–1. How single-minded at a BIG MOMENT (its main goal's best move reaches that goal's bar in goals.json): only moves at least this good for the main goal are considered (0 = any move, 1 = only the best); the other goals just break ties — it pounces. On ordinary turns it blends.
_help.sight: 0–1 per goal: how clearly it judges that kind of move (missing = 1, sees clearly). Low sight blurs those scores, so it misjudges them — the Scholar can't see a trap closing on it. How many WORDS it knows comes from the skill (Apprentice … Archmage), never the personality.
_help.steady.SCORE: 0–1. How much EVERY move also tries to score, whatever goal it rolled (Muzzy: "try to score, but also try to bully"). 0 = only when it rolled SCORE.
_help.shifts: Mood shifts: when a reading (0–10) climbs from `from` to `full`, the trait's whole range moves by up to `by`. `from` above `full` = it grows as the reading FALLS. Readings: myDanger, rivalDanger, fill (board fill), behind / ahead (believed Magic gap), handQuality (10 = great), territory, endNear.
_help.chattiness: 0–100: how likely it is to say something at a banter moment (big moments only).
_help.extras.nerve: How far ahead (in believed Magic) it must think it is before it ends the game itself ("calls it"). Lower = bolder, calls it wrong more often.
_help.extras.extraWordBonus: SCORE goal: bonus per extra word made in one cast (the original: 3). The Strategist — the two-words-one-move specialist — gets more.

_labels.nudge: Two-birds nudge from the other goals (0–1)
_labels.steady: Goals every move also tries for
_labels.sight: How clearly it sees each kind of move (0–1)
_labels.extras.nerve: Calls it when it thinks it's this far ahead (Magic)
_labels.extras.extraWordBonus: SCORE: bonus per extra word in one cast
